offer.text: One of our own is turning — the zombie-sickness has them. A golden apple, used in time, can still save them. Please, before it's too late!

accept.text: Hurry to them. Every moment counts.

decline.text: Then we can only bar the doors and grieve.

in_progress.text: Have you reached them? Use the golden apple before they turn.

complete.text: You pulled them back from the dark. The whole village breathes easier.

failed.text: We were too slow. The rot took them. May they rest.
